pseudoClasses.name: :host
pseudoClasses.description: Selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS

pseudoClasses.name: :host()
pseudoClasses.description: Selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS, but only if the selector given as the function's parameter matches the shadow host

pseudoClasses.name: :host-context()
pseudoClasses.description: Selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS, but only if the selector given as the function's parameter matches an ancestor of the shadow host

pseudoElements.name: ::slotted
pseudoElements.description: Represents any element that has been placed into a slot inside an HTML template

pseudoElements.name: ::part
pseudoElements.description: Represents any element within a shadow tree that has a matching part attribute
